newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING launches new AEX stock index note.
newsitem.headline: ING launches new AEX stock index note.

text.p: Financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV (ING) said on Wednesday it was to introduce a "safe" investment whereby investors could profit from a rise in the Dutch AEX share index without losing their investment.
The ING Bank Index Performance Note will be available in denominations of 1,000 guilders with the first tranche paying 127.5 percent of any gain in the AEX over five years.
Should the index fall, investors would get their money back but without any interest. "It's a way of betting on the index without losing your money," said a spokesman.
Subscription to the first tranche is open until October 1. A fresh tranche of the instrument will be issued every month, the bank said in a statement.

The spokesman said ING's team of investment managers would be expected to use their expertise to generate the profit to pay out investors and cover costs involved in the scheme. -- Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5000
